title: Đề mẫu Writing (dummy)
description: Self-written placeholder prompts; the chart data is fictional (CC0).

tasks.prompt:
The chart below shows the number of passengers (in thousands) using three ferry routes on Lake Varden in five different years between 2015 and 2023.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Some people believe that city centres should be closed to private cars and given over to pedestrians and cyclists. Others think this would harm local businesses.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
